rules.logic: ABIOC("ITDR-014 Programmatic Entra Sign-In From Rogue roadtx Automation User-Agent") AND ABIOC("ITDR-014 Rogue Device Registration Burst Following First Programmatic Sign-In") joined on the same user_principal_name within 900 seconds — the sign-in and the DRS device registration share the compromised identity, and the registration emits the rogue device_detail_device_id. That device identity is then joined to BIOC("ITDR-014 PRT-Backed Silent Token Minting With MFA Satisfied By Refresh Token") and ABIOC("ITDR-014 Bulk Microsoft Graph Directory Enumeration Burst From Rogue Device Identity") on the SHARED device_detail_device_id: the PRT minted on the rogue device and the Graph enumeration burst both carry that same device id, tying the cloud-token abuse and the Discovery tail to the one rogue device. Finally the endpoint spine ABIOC("ITDR-014 roadrecon Graph Enumeration Process Descends From roadtx Causality Owner") is joined on the roadtx causality_actor_process_instance_id and the acting user_principal_name, folding the roadtx to roadrecon process lineage from xdr_data into the same identity. All five signals fuse into a single identity-owned ITDR incident whose causality anchor is the rogue device object id + PRT — programmatic sign-in -> DRS registration -> PRT silent token mint (MFA bypass) -> roadtx-owned roadrecon lineage -> Graph enumeration burst — presented to the DC as end-to-end evidence of the ROADtools storyline.
rules.name: ITDR-014 roadtx Entra Token-Abuse Identity-Owned Incident Stitch
